tier_3_assist.constraint: Non-production scaffolding only, must be refined by Tier 1 before gate evaluation

escalation_rules.E-01: deepseek-v4-flash fails 3 consecutive attempts on a single task -> Escalate to deepseek-v4-pro
escalation_rules.E-02: deepseek-v4-pro fails 2 consecutive attempts or encounters architectural ambiguity -> Escalate to Tier 2 (claude-sonnet-5)
escalation_rules.E-03: claude-sonnet-5 reasoning failure -> Escalate to claude-opus-5
escalation_rules.E-04: claude-opus-5 ceiling failure (when agentic execution is the bottleneck) -> Escalate to gemini-3.1-pro-preview
escalation_rules.E-05: gemini-3.6-flash fails 2x -> Escalate to gemini-3.1-pro-preview (2x) -> Escalate to human review
escalation_rules.E-06: Security Gate Failure (S1-S4) -> Mechanical fixes return to deepseek-v4-flash; architectural/ambiguous security failures escalate directly to claude-sonnet-5 minimum
escalation_rules.E-07: Claude Fable 5 Access -> Requires explicit, documented justification prior to invocation
